meta.prompt: Show me the flights from London to Lisbon this Friday (20 Nov) as an inline card I can pick from. There are two of us flying, 2 adults, and the prices are per person. Three direct options: TAP Air Portugal 07:15 to 09:50, 2h 35m, £128, tagged Best time; easyJet 11:40 to 14:20, 2h 40m, £84, tagged Cheapest; British Airways 18:05 to 20:40, 2h 35m, £156. The first one is selected to start, the total is for both of us and follows my choice, and the confirm button tells you which flight I chose.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Flights to Lisbon" "Friday 20 Nov · 2 adults" icon:"flight" status:"3 direct" tone:accent
  SectionLabel "Choose a flight" "per person"
  state pick=1
  FlightOption "TAP Air Portugal" depart:"07:15" arrive:"09:50" origin:"LON" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 35m" stops:"Direct" price:"£128" tag:"Best time" selected:{pick==1} -> pick=1
  FlightOption "easyJet" depart:"11:40" arrive:"14:20" origin:"LON" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 40m" stops:"Direct" price:"£84" tag:"Cheapest" selected:{pick==2} -> pick=2
  FlightOption "British Airways" depart:"18:05" arrive:"20:40" origin:"LON" destination:"LIS" duration:"2h 35m" stops:"Direct" price:"£156" selected:{pick==3} -> pick=3
  let fare = pick==1 ? 128 : pick==2 ? 84 : 156
  let total = fare * 2
  Details rows:=[["Price per person", money(fare,"£",0)],["Passengers","2 adults"],["Total", money(total,"£",0)]]
  TotalBar "Total for 2 adults" "Friday 20 Nov" amount:{money(total,"£",0)} cta:"Confirm" -> emit confirm pick
